scope: Attempted one composed regional-v4, birth-v7 PhysicsWorld and Biosphere assay with native regulation, routes, outlets, growth, a physical obstruction, one complete face exit, and exact continuation. Execution stopped during the analyst exit setup before the 1200-tick continuation; no claim is made for the unexecuted portion.

executed_findings.construction: B8 PhysicsWorld and Biosphere construction succeeded before each attempt.
executed_findings.route_accessibility: All authored route accessibility values were already zero in the initial physical scene, so an additional route-obstruction effect was not feasible and is not claimed.
executed_findings.outlet_obstruction: Physical play-block entities were placed at every outlet. Advancing the regional owner through the first outlet interval emitted no outlet slot and retained total regional inventory within 1e-12.
executed_findings.exit_setup_failure: A finite deposit into living-deposit-18 returned no active physical free entity, including when requested at its authored material-outlet-00 position. The assay stopped rather than bypass physical clearance or fabricate an exit.
